Supreme Court to Hear Trump Admin's Plea on Withholding DOGE Records

The U.S. Supreme Court has agreed to hear a plea from the Trump administration seeking to withhold internal documents related to Dogecoin (DOGE). The administration's request concerns records that could potentially be linked to Elon Musk.
